subject: Analytical Reasoning
title: Word Analogy — Set 1
directions: DIRECTIONS: Determine how the first pair of capitalized words is related. From the choices, select the word that gives the second pair the same relationship.
example: Example — HAMMER : CARPENTER :: STETHOSCOPE : ___. A hammer is the tool of a carpenter; a stethoscope is the tool of a physician. The answer is PHYSICIAN.
